id: qc-04
title: Annealing dynamics
paper: King et al., Beyond-classical computation in quantum simulation (arXiv Mar 2024; Science 2025; v2 Oct 2025)
link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.00910
type: Benchmark
cutoff: 2024-03-01
domain: qc
profile: advantage

## expected_verdict
Contested / Inconclusive. The QPU's agreement with converged MPS on small and mid-size spin-glass quenches is supported. The "beyond classical" claim rests on extrapolating MPS cost. Two independent groups (BP tensor networks; t-VMC) since report comparable accuracy at modest cost on some lattices. The verdict must record supported subclaims and unresolved comparisons, not pick a winner.

## I0
Can an annealer reproduce spin-glass dynamics outside a declared classical accuracy budget?

## evidence
- Task: transverse-field Ising quench of spin glasses on 2D square (cylinders), dimerized cubic, diamond, and biclique (infinite-dimensional) graphs; D-Wave Advantage and an Advantage2 prototype; quench times ~2–20 ns; Kibble–Zurek universality checks on >5,000-qubit cubic glasses.
- Metric: median two-point correlation error ε_c vs converged MPS ground truth (χ up to ~256+ on Summit / Frontier); QPU error roughly constant across sizes (Fig. 2–4).
- Classical comparators: MPS (TDVP), PEPS, neural quantum states; all but MPS "failed at smaller sizes" to match QPU error.
- Area-law entanglement → stretched-exponential growth of required MPS bond dimension; extrapolation to a few hundred qubits gives millions of years on Frontier, memory >700 PB, energy above annual global consumption (Fig. 5D).
- Authors stress the extrapolation applies to MPS, "the only method" that succeeded up to the sizes tested.

## intake
- Scope: (A) QPU reproduces Schrödinger dynamics of quenched spin glasses to a stated ε_c; (B) no classical method can reach that ε_c at the largest sizes in feasible time.
- Regime: specific lattices, sizes and quench times; correlation-error metric; MPS-based ground truth.
- Assumptions: converged MPS is a valid ground truth; MPS cost scaling is representative of the best classical approach; ε_c is the right accuracy metric.
- Falsifiers: a classical method matching the QPU's ε_c at large sizes with polynomial resources; or ground-truth errors.

## screen
- Must flag: the impossibility estimate extrapolates one method (MPS); geometry-aware tensor networks and variational Monte Carlo were not exhausted; results differ by lattice (biclique vs 2D/3D).
- Must request: per-lattice comparison with the best available methods at matched ε_c and identical instances.

## retrieval
- Pre-cutoff must-finds: earlier coherent-annealing experiments on 1D chains and small spin glasses; TDVP / MPS dynamics; Kibble–Zurek in quantum annealers; Begušić & Chan and Tindall et al. 2023 (classical rebuttals of the IBM utility claim, same pattern).
- Current mode: Tindall et al. 2025: lattice-specific BP tensor networks reach "state-of-the-art accuracies" with modest resources in 2D and 3D, hundreds of qubits; Mauron & Carleo 2025: t-VMC with Jastrow–Feenberg states, up to 128 spins on 3D diamond, correlation errors <7%, polynomial cost. D-Wave replies exist; the dispute is live.

## designer
- Reconcile both sides on identical instances, quench times and ε_c tolerance, per lattice; report the largest size each classical method reaches at QPU-level error, with wall-clock.

## champion
- BP tensor networks (Tindall et al.) for 2D/3D lattices; t-VMC (Mauron & Carleo) for diamond; MPS as the paper's own reference.

## panel
- Flaw: impossibility claim from extrapolating one method. Repair: scope claim B to "beyond MPS, PEPS and NQS as implemented" and test against newer methods.

## run
- Small instance (e.g. 6×6 square, t_a = 7 ns): compute ε_c with MPS and a BP tensor network; QPU data from the paper's release. Large-scale runs out of scope.

## verdict
- Label: Inconclusive (contested). A Supported; B Disputed, with lattice-dependent counterevidence.
- Must say: which lattices/sizes remain unmatched by any classical method; that challenges match accuracy on some lattices; that replies exist.
- Must not say: beyond-classical is established; or it is refuted.

## audit
- Check: lattice list; ε_c metric; "millions of years on Frontier", 700 PB; Mauron & Carleo 128 spins, <7%; Tindall et al. scope (2D and 3D). Mauron & Carleo citation missing from indexes (confirm in PDF; inventory note).

## variants
- The cheapest discriminating comparison: biclique (infinite-dimensional) instances at the largest size, where tree-like BP should struggle, against t-VMC and MPS.
